```{r}
# Define fire periods for Calperum
# Fire occurred January 2014

calperum_partitioned <- sites_daily_capped[["Cpr"]] %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      date < as.Date("2014-01-01")                                      ~ "Pre-fire",
      date >= as.Date("2014-01-01") & date < as.Date("2015-01-01")      ~ "During/post-fire",
      date >= as.Date("2015-01-01")                                     ~ "Post-fire recovery"
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-fire", "During/post-fire", "Post-fire recovery"))
  )

# Then run the same binning and slope fitting per period
calperum_slopes <- map_dfr(c("Pre-fire", "During/post-fire", "Post-fire recovery"), function(p) {
  
  df <- calperum_partitioned %>% filter(period == p)
  
  binned <- df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  vpd_at_peak <- binned$vpd_mid[which.max(binned$gpp_norm)]
  descending  <- binned %>% filter(vpd_mid >= vpd_at_peak)
  
  if (nrow(descending) < 3) {
    return(tibble(period = p, intercept = NA, slope = NA,
                  vpd_at_peak = NA, n_bins = nrow(descending)))
  }
  
  model <- lm(gpp_norm ~ vpd_mid, data = descending)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  tibble(
    period      = p,
    intercept   = coefs[1],
    slope       = coefs[2],
    vpd_at_peak = vpd_at_peak,
    n_bins      = nrow(descending)
  )
})
```

```{r}
period_colours <- c(
  "Pre-fire"             = "#6699CC",
  "During/post-fire"     = "#CC6677",
  "Post-fire recovery"   = "#44AA99"
)

# Generate fitted lines per period
calperum_fitted <- calperum_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    period  = period,
    vpd_mid = seq(vpd_at_peak, 6, by = 0.05),
    fitted  = intercept + slope * vpd_mid
  )

# Point cloud per period
calperum_cloud <- calperum_partitioned %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
  mutate(gpp_norm = GPP / max(GPP, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data  = calperum_cloud,
    aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = period),
    size  = 0.4, alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data      = calperum_fitted,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = period),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data     = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak, colour = period),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(label  = paste0("β = ", round(slope, 3)),
        colour = period),
    x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4,
    size = 3.2, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = period_colours, name = "Fire period") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
  labs(
    x = "VPD (kPa)",
    y = "Normalised GPP",
    title = "Calperum: GPP-VPD sensitivity across fire periods"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data  = calperum_cloud,
    aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = period),
    size  = 0.4, alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data      = calperum_fitted,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = period),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data     = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak, colour = period),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(label  = paste0("β = ", round(slope, 3), "\nVPD peak = ",
                        round(vpd_at_peak, 2), " kPa"),
        colour = period),
    x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 3, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(period,
                      levels = c("Pre-fire", "During/post-fire", "Post-fire recovery")),
             ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = period_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
  labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
# Partition Howard Springs into three equal time periods
how_partitioned <- sites_daily_capped[["How"]] %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      date < as.Date("2006-01-01")                                    ~ "Early (2001-2005)",
      date >= as.Date("2006-01-01") & date < as.Date("2011-01-01")    ~ "Middle (2006-2010)",
      date >= as.Date("2011-01-01")                                   ~ "Late (2011-2015)"
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Early (2001-2005)",
                                       "Middle (2006-2010)",
                                       "Late (2011-2015)"))
  )

# Fit slopes per period using same method as main analysis
how_slopes <- map_dfr(levels(how_partitioned$period), function(p) {
  
  df <- how_partitioned %>% filter(period == p)
  
  binned <- df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n       = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  vpd_at_peak <- binned$vpd_mid[which.max(binned$gpp_norm)]
  descending  <- binned %>% filter(vpd_mid >= vpd_at_peak)
  
  if (nrow(descending) < 3) {
    return(tibble(period = p, intercept = NA, slope = NA,
                  vpd_at_peak = NA, n_bins = nrow(descending)))
  }
  
  model <- lm(gpp_norm ~ vpd_mid, data = descending)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  tibble(
    period      = p,
    intercept   = coefs[1],
    slope       = coefs[2],
    vpd_at_peak = vpd_at_peak,
    n_bins      = nrow(descending)
  )
})

# Point cloud
how_cloud <- how_partitioned %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
  mutate(gpp_norm = GPP / max(GPP, na.rm = TRUE))

# Fitted lines
how_fitted <- how_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    period  = period,
    vpd_mid = seq(vpd_at_peak, 6, by = 0.05),
    fitted  = intercept + slope * vpd_mid
  )
```
